decisions.reason: The dumper was only mentioned on the website rather than presented on its own page, which signals weak commitment, and the firm has already shown it prunes heavy-vehicle lines quickly (A and B), so likely underperformance against aspirations points to redirecting these resources.

The inclined furniture lift is a low-cost niche product with steady demand from movers, it was presented on its own page, and it fits the firm's lifting know-how, so it likely meets modest aspirations without straining slack.

The building material lift shares its technology and service base with the furniture lift and serves strong German construction and renovation demand, making it cheap to carry and likely satisfactory.

The truck-mounted variant is more capital-intensive and has a narrower market, but it builds on the same lift platform and was given its own page, so management would likely keep it rather than start search.
